subject: Horizon Systems / AWS co-sell demo — calendar handoff and final runbook
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Miguel Torres <miguel@horizon-sys.com>, Beth Newman <beth.newman@amazon.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Horizon Systems / AWS co-sell demo — calendar handoff and final runbook

Hi Miguel, Beth —

Thanks again for agreeing to a joint demo for Horizon Systems' payments orchestration pilot. The goal for this session is to walk through Redwood Inference powering low-latency decisioning for the Horizon checkout flow, surface throughput/latency numbers, and confirm integration requirements for the AWS marketplace listing.

Proposed format (60 minutes):
- 10m intros & agenda
- 25m live demo (checkout flow + privacy notes)
- 15m SI technical deep-dive (Horizon runbook + infra requirements)
- 10m next steps / procurement cadence

We have these windows next week (all in PDT):
- Tue 13 Apr 09:00–10:00
- Tue 13 Apr 13:00–14:00
- Wed 14 Apr 11:00–12:00

I've attached a runbook (Horizon-demo-runbook-v2.pdf) and a short briefing doc. Can you confirm which slot works for you and whether Horizon will include your SI technical lead for the deep-dive?

Thanks — I’ll coordinate invites once you confirm.

—
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: Horizon-demo-runbook-v2.pdf, redwood-demo-briefing-notes.docx
From: Miguel Torres <miguel@horizon-sys.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@horizon-sys.com
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Horizon Systems / AWS co-sell demo — calendar handoff and final runbook

Thanks Rachel — appreciate the clear agenda.

A couple notes from Horizon: we have two engineering leads who we want on the call (myself and Priya Shah, our infra lead). Priya is only available after 12:00 CDT on Tue/Wed (so that maps to 10:00 PDT onward). Would you be able to do Tue 13 Apr 13:00–14:00 PDT? That would be easiest for the team.

Also: can you add a short bullet in the runbook about the VPC peering/network egress expectations for multi-region failover? Our security team asked for a one-paragraph summary to attach to the vendor evaluation doc.

Miguel
Head of Partnerships, Horizon Systems
miguel@horizon-sys.com
